thread:
alex (pm): Ok team, RC ready for staged promo. RC tag rc-2026-03-db03 built. Staging migration ran clean. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/rc-db-migrate-4312345999
sam (eng): ran schema diff, looks good. Pinning artifacts: `service-worker@sha:9c7d1a`, `migration-runner@v2.3.0`
lee (release): Quiet window 23:30-01:30 UTC. Plan: KV warm, DB migration feature-flag on, darklaunch feature flag for new routing off until 100%. Cohorts: 3% -> 20% -> 100%.
tina (sre): I'll standby on monitoring. Baseline p99=95ms; db-write error-rate=0.02%. If db write errors > 0.5% or replication lag > 2s we pause.
lee (release): deploy-bot, schedule RC job with pins and migration toggle. `--kv-warm --cohorts=3,20,100 --pin=service-worker@9c7d1a,migration-runner@v2.3.0 --flag=db-migrate=on`
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted. Job ID: 2026-03-db-4312345999. Canary will start in 8m. Progress will post here.
alex (pm): Note: this RC includes a small customer-visible change to latency when writes hit new index. Mentioned in notes.
sam (eng): migration-runner will do backfill in a background job. It's incremental. We set a throttling cap at 200rps.
lee (release): canary started. Cohort 1 -> 3% traffic. KV warming.
tina (sre): KV warm done. Initial metrics good. p50/p90/p99: 18ms/72ms/92ms. write error-rate 0.01%. replication lag 0.1s.
sam (eng): monitoring the migration log. Backfill batch 1 completed, batches/sec ~150. No schema locks.
lee (release): promoting cohort 2 -> 20% in 10m if metrics hold.
deploy-bot: Cohort 2 promoted. Traffic at 20%. migration flag still on.
alex (pm): Heads-up: analytics team will read new index columns later, they know the schema change.
tina (sre): saw a small rise in DB write latency on a subset of pods (+120ms) but not errors. Traces: https://tracing.redwood/trace/db-xyz-sample
sam (eng): probably due to backfill writes contending on index. Throttle lowered to 100rps to ease pressure.
lee (release): throttle change applied. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Backfill rate adjusted to 100rps by release-bot command.
tina (sre): replication lag rose to 1.9s for a minute but now trending down. write error-rate 0.04%. still under pause threshold.
alex (pm): ok to continue if lag stabilizes below 1.5s in next 5m.
sam (eng): agree. Also toggling temporary routing flag to route heavy writes to replica pool. `feature-flag route-heavy-writes=replica-pool`
lee (release): applied flag for cohort 20%.
lee (release): scheduling final promote to 100% after 15m observation window. extend window to 25m just in case.
deploy-bot: Final promote scheduled. Will proceed after 25m if no pauses.
tina (sre): alert: replication lag spiked to 3.4s and write errors ticked to 0.7% across 2 regions. Pausing final promote and rolling back write flag to previous state.
lee (release): acknowledging pause. Rolling traffic back to 20%. Rolling back `route-heavy-writes` flag for safety.
sam (eng): looking at migration-runner logs: batch spike where a shard retried 3x due to transient DB timeout. We're patching backoff logic now. If we can't contain, we should abort migration and rollback to previous RC.
alex (pm): prefer not to rollback to previous RC yet if patch and backoff fix can be applied within 10m. What's ETA?
sam (eng): I can push a backoff patch and restart the backfill within ~8m. It's already staged.
tina (sre): SRE OK with that plan if we keep traffic at 20% and throttles low. I'll hold the pause for 20m. If errors don't drop under 0.3% we will abort.
lee (release): preparing deploy-bot command to apply patch to migration-runner on the cohort. `deploy-bot run-job --job=2026-03-db-4312345999 --task=apply-backoff-patch`
deploy-bot: Patch job queued. Applying to migration-runner instances in cohort 20%.
deploy-bot: Patch applied. Restarting backfill process.
tina (sre): after patch, write error-rate down to 0.15%, replication lag 0.9s. Good signals.
sam (eng): backfill resumed with improved backoff. batches/sec steady at 90.
lee (release): all gates green. Proceeding with final promote. Cohort 3 -> 100%. --feature-flag db-migrate remains on.
deploy-bot: Final promote started. Shifting traffic to RC rc-2026-03-db03. Post-promote checks running.
tina (sre): post-promote telemetry: p99 108ms, write error-rate 0.12%. replication lag stable. No more alerts.
alex (pm): official sign-off: promoted. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/notes/rc-db-migrate-4312345999. Please add post-release item to improve backoff+observability for migration runner.
sam (eng): will open PR to increase backoff cap and add shard-level metrics.
lee (release): tagging release and recording pins: `git tag rc-2026-03-db03 && git push --tags`. infra pins: `service-worker@9c7d1a`, `migration-runner@v2.3.0`.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Job ID: 2026-03-db-4312345999. Thread archived as release record.
alex (pm): thanks all. I'll follow up with a short post-release review tomorrow.
tina (sre): adding timeline to ops-log and closing monitor unless anything else pops up.
sam (eng): thanks, will send the PR after lunch.
lee (release): out.
